_doc: Services the build host's pull deployer (deployer.py) deploys from blinky_time master. A gated master commit that changes any of a service's paths (since the commit it runs) is deployed by running its deploy script from a checkout of that commit; a failed deploy rolls back to the commit before. An empty deploy only checks the commit out: the deployer entry moves this clone (the code the timer runs) to a gated change of the deployer itself, which no other service may be due for. Keep it last, so a rollback earlier in the pass cannot leave the clone behind it. required: check runs that must be green on the master commit (on top of every check being green and the PR's Claude review being clean).
